# Hackathon Context: clone-able kit for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon

> A context kit any team can clone for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 to Nov 4, 2026). It breaks the event into short sections you can check in a minute, collects notes on Meta's developer platform, and ships agent configs, guides, templates and a few stdlib tools. It names no project: point your own repos at it.

## Start here
- [README.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric/blob/main/hackathon/README.md): what this is and how to run it
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric/blob/main/hackathon/AGENTS.md): rules every agent follows here
- [INDEX.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric/blob/main/hackathon/INDEX.md): every file with a description
- [KEYWORDS.md](https://github.com/ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric/blob/main/hackathon/KEYWORDS.md): where each term appears
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/ta-amps/teleionlabs-teleion-fabric/blob/main/hackathon/llms-full.txt): the main documents in full, in reading order
